original: Lake WPRPLACE is located in southern Lithuania's Alytus County. The lake, covering 1,292 hectares, has a maximum depth of 15 metres. It lies within the boundaries of Meteliai Regional Park. Lake WPRPLACE formed from melted ice lump.
